items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: I went there with Bud Harris.

ctx.x: I know. He was nice... And so he knew me. After I met him, he knew me. And then, when I went to Chicago... Let me see, this was '32. I went there with Bud Harris. We stayed at a hotel of that a man owned that owned the Grand Terrace.
